name: fnb-paediatric-oncology-hackathon
title: Anonymised patients, care episodes and laboratory results - FN Brno
description: Three linked tables: patients (one row per patient x tumour), episodes (one row per care episode) and labs (one row per laboratory result), joined by patient_id and episode_id. No calendar dates or direct identifiers are released. Days count from the patient's first episode; E001 always starts on day 0. Every later episode is shifted by a random -3..+3 days for anonymisation (start and end together, so its length is exact); a shift that would change the episode order was not applied. Pseudonymised data - use only under the hackathon data use agreement; do not attempt to re-identify patients.

resources.name: patients
resources.description: One row per patient x tumour (anonymised tumour registry extract). Only patients with at least one episode or lab result are included.

fields.name: patient_id
fields.description: Patient pseudonym, assigned in random order; same as in episodes.csv / labs.csv.

fields.name: tumor_id
fields.description: Tumour sequence within the patient, ordered by diagnosis date.

fields.name: sex
fields.description: Sex (source pohlavi: 1 = M, 2 = F).

fields.name: age_group
fields.description: Age at diagnosis in completed years: 0-5, then 3-year groups (6-8, 9-11, ...).

fields.name: dx_icd10
fields.description: Tumour diagnosis, ICD-10 (Czech MKN-10), 3-character category only (e.g. C91).

fields.name: topography_icdo3
fields.description: Tumour site, ICD-O-3 topography, e.g. C41.4.

fields.name: morphology_icdo3
fields.description: Histology/behaviour, ICD-O-3 morphology, e.g. 9753/3 (/1 = uncertain behaviour, /3 = malignant).

fields.name: laterality
fields.description: Laterality code as in the Czech National Cancer Registry (NOR).

fields.name: grade
fields.description: Grade / differentiation code (NOR; 9 = unknown).

fields.name: stage
fields.description: Clinical stage code (NOR), e.g. 1, 2A, 4; 9 = unknown.

fields.name: extent
fields.description: Extent of disease code (NOR).

fields.name: t
fields.description: Clinical TNM - T category.

fields.name: n
fields.description: Clinical TNM - N category.

fields.name: m
fields.description: Clinical TNM - M category.

fields.name: pt
fields.description: Pathological TNM - pT.

fields.name: pn
fields.description: Pathological TNM - pN.

fields.name: psu
fields.description: Source field psu (pathological TNM supplement) - meaning to be confirmed.

fields.name: pm
fields.description: Pathological TNM - pM.

fields.name: deceased
fields.description: 1 = patient deceased, 0 = alive at registry export.

resources.name: episodes
resources.description: One row per care episode (inpatient stay or outpatient contact). Days count from the patient's first episode; E001 always starts on day 0. Every later episode is shifted by a random -3..+3 days for anonymisation (start and end together, so its length is exact); a shift that would change the episode order was not applied.

fields.name: patient_id
fields.description: Patient pseudonym (links to patients).

fields.name: episode_id
fields.description: Episode id <patient_id>-E<seq>, numbered in chronological order within the patient.

fields.name: day_start
fields.description: Start day (E001 = day 0; later episodes shifted by -3..+3 days).

fields.name: day_end
fields.description: End day, shifted together with day_start. day_end = day_start for outpatient contacts, >= day_start for inpatient stays; empty = inpatient stay with missing discharge date.

fields.name: dx_main
fields.description: Main diagnosis as coded in the source, ICD-10 3-character category only (e.g. C91): DGZakladni for inpatient stays, DGH for outpatient contacts; empty = not coded.

resources.name: labs
resources.description: One row per numeric laboratory result of the released panels.

fields.name: patient_id
fields.description: Patient pseudonym (links to patients).

fields.name: episode_id
fields.description: Episode the sample falls into (inpatient stay covering the sampling time, else the same-day outpatient contact); empty = outside any episode.

fields.name: day
fields.description: Sampling day on the episodes time axis. A result inside an episode is shifted together with that episode; a result outside episodes has its own random -3..+3 day shift. Can be negative if sampled before the first episode.

fields.name: test_code
fields.description: FN Brno internal laboratory method code; keep as text (leading zeros).

fields.name: panel
fields.description: Laboratory panel.

fields.name: value
fields.description: Numeric result. Results reported as below/above a detection limit ('<', '>') appear as the limit value itself - they are not marked in this release.

fields.name: unit
fields.description: Unit as reported by the laboratory (e.g. 'x10 9/l', 'mmol/l', 'ukat/l').

fields.name: ref_low
fields.description: Lower reference limit as reported (may be adult ranges); empty = no usable range.

fields.name: ref_high
fields.description: Upper reference limit as reported; empty = no usable range.

fields.name: flag
fields.description: L / N / H against the reported range; empty = no usable range.
